# Ed synthetic contract v1

These fixtures are hand-written synthetic examples for the isolated Ed beta
adapter contract. They are not production captures and do not prove that the
unofficial Ed API is stable.

`v1` versions the repository fixture format, not the upstream Ed API. Existing
fixtures are immutable contract evidence; incompatible fixture changes require
a new sibling version. Tokens, authorization headers, signed URLs, real school
domains, account identifiers, and real course content are forbidden here.
